description: This file defines a PHP class for handling and displaying error exceptions within the OpenCart admin interface. It constructs an error page with breadcrumbs and common layout components.

classes.name: Exception
classes.description: Controller class for handling and displaying error exceptions in the admin interface, extending the core Controller class.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of an exception page, setting up breadcrumb navigation, page title, and rendering the error view with provided error details.
